ui.hero.title: One platform for every animal in your care (formal)
ui.hero.sub: Records, daily activities and teamwork across all locations. Every task in Antz, shown on real screens.
ui.modules.lede: Touching a card opens the guide to the module with all the functions and screens.
ui.cta.text: Every module has a description of functions and real screens in this guide. One can return to the place where one left off, or write to us — we will gladly help.
ui.day.title: What the first day with Antz looks like
ui.day.4.desc: One should create roles matching the structure of the organization and switch on permissions module by module, so that each person sees what they need in their work.
ui.faq.q2: Does it work on phones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile application handles field work, such as notes, treatment, transfers and egg registers. The web application handles office work, such as the hospital system, rearing facility configuration, reports and pharmacy stock. Changes appear in real time on the phone, tablet and computer.
ui.faq.q3: Can one control who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is based on roles. You (formal) create the roles used in the organization, for example Zoologist, and switch on permissions module by module.
ui.faq.q4: We have more than one location. Will it work?
ui.faq.a4: Antz stores data from all locations and departments in one place. Animal rooms are organized by location, section and enclosure, and transfers between locations require approval and exit inspection by security.
ui.faq.a5: It is best to start with the "First steps" guide, and then open the modules that your (formal) role uses. In case of doubt, please write to hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Autopsy
m.necropsy.intro: The Autopsy module documents post-mortem examinations with detailed observations, results for individual organs and medical conclusions. It supports accurate analysis of the cause of death, unifies reporting, ensures timely handling of remains and meets legal, audit and veterinary standards.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search and filters
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Searching by animal/species; filtering by location, date, priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Monitoring stages: Incoming, Pending, Draft and Finished.
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card and order details
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, place, cause, orderer, priority.
m.deworming.title: Deworming
m.deworming.intro: The Deworming module supports systematic recording and monitoring of antiparasitic treatments, ensuring timely administration, proper documentation and transparent tracking of every deworming in every animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: Views by status
m.deworming.f1.desc: Dewormings divided into Upcoming, Pending, Skipped and Done for easy monitoring.
m.deworming.f2.title: Deworming management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Planning a course of treatment or directly recording the medicine given with specified dates and details.
m.deworming.f3.title: Administration registration
m.deworming.f3.desc: Recording of dosage, batch number, route of administration, notes and an optional follow-up visit.
m.housing.title: Rooms for animals
m.housing.intro: The Rooms for animals module organizes animal habitats across all locations, sections and enclosures, so that the place of every animal is known and every change is recorded. Access at each level depends on permissions.
m.housing.f1.title: Administering locations
m.housing.f1.desc: Adding and editing locations with role-based permissions, ensuring safe and orderly access.
m.housing.f2.title: Administering sections
m.housing.f2.desc: Adding and editing sections in the zoo with permission-based control, ensuring safe administration.
m.housing.f3.title: Administering enclosures
m.housing.f3.desc: Adding and editing enclosures and monitoring each of them for efficient oversight of animals and data.
m.fetal-death.title: Fetal demise
m.fetal-death.intro: The Fetal demise module records and manages cases of fetal demise in enclosures, noting the cause, time and related animal data. It supports veterinary care, monitoring of reproductive health, trend analysis and better population management.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Adding a fetal demise entry
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Recording new cases: cause, time, parents, animal data.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search and filters
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Searching by keyword; filtering by location, date, stillbirth or miscarriage, species or sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: Viewing death entries
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Full data, number of days since death, cause, ID, enclosure, location, sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The Eggs module tracks the full life cycle of eggs — from laying to hatching or transfer to the rearing facility — ensuring accurate documentation, real-time updates and full identifiability, which improves coordination and accountability of the nest, rearing facility and hatchery teams.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg dashboard
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Current numbers: eggs in nests, transferred to the rearing facility, designated for disposal.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Entering eggs (nest / rearing facility)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Adding eggs with parents, condition, dates, species, notes and attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, mass and the full timeline of the egg's journey (Egg Journey Timeline). [?]
m.administer-medicine.title: Administering medicines
m.administer-medicine.intro: The Administering module supplements medical documentation, translating prescriptions into concrete treatment processes and enabling care to be given in real time to individual animals or groups, in the field or in the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Creating a direct administration entry for a chosen date without drawing up a full medical entry.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search and filters
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Quickly searching entries and narrowing the list by date, facility/object, species and controlled substance. [?]
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: Viewing treatment by date on four cards: Pending, Administered, Skipped, Suspended.
m.vaccination.title: Vaccinations
m.vaccination.intro: The Vaccinations module handles the full cycle of animal vaccinations — from planning and direct administration to tracking upcoming, pending, skipped and done vaccinations. It ensures timely procedures, accurate recording of doses and full identifiability for disease prevention and clinical compliance.
m.vaccination.f1.title: Views by status
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Vaccinations divided into Upcoming, Pending, Skipped and Done for easy monitoring.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Planning a vaccination or directly recording the vaccine given with specified dates and medicine details.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Administration registration
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Recording of dosage, batch number, route of administration, notes and an optional follow-up visit.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Enables fast, accurate and identifiable dispensing of medicinal products directly to authorized physicians, ensuring timely fulfillment and automatic updating of stock levels — from the prescription to the shelf — with insight at batch level and tracking of expiry dates at every stage.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Dashboard
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Current information on stock problems, deliveries, purchases, orders, consumption, expiry dates and fast-rotating products, with visualization of trends facilitating quick action.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search and filters
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Quickly searching entries by order ID, physician's surname or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Basic data (racks and shelves)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Organizing the warehouse by number of racks and shelves for quick access and updates, with configurable data (packaging, units of measure, active substances, drivers, manufacturers). [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Managing stock level reports
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Stock levels by batch with value and expiry date; marking items with low stock or expired; monitoring approaching expiry dates; managing the deposit with dispute resolution. [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Managing products and warehouse
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Creating products, tracking stock levels and expiry dates, recording purchases and shipments, keeping a unified ledger, handling substitutes and variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Managing dispensing
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Physicians can prescribe and dispense medicines or collect them directly from the pharmacy — everything is recorded.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Managing deliveries
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Tracking incoming and outgoing deliveries of medicines and fulfilling them in the application.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Stock adjustments and reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Recording stock changes (shortages, damage, expiry); keeping a history of changes; handling returns to suppliers; downloading reports of consumption, returns, purchases and issues for finance and demand planning.
m.getting-started.title: First steps
m.getting-started.intro: The "First steps" guide presents the purpose of the application and leads new users through the most important stages: configuring a profile, getting to know the key functions and moving around the platform smoothly.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access and workspaces
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Secure logging in and access to the assigned work environment.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation and interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: A feed on the home screen with news, shortcuts for quick navigation and a bottom panel with essential tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Pending autopsies / medicine administrations / assignments [?]
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals awaiting autopsy, administrative documentation and further assignment or disposal before the final closing of the records.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Basic configuration and modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Configuring basic data and getting to know modules such as medical records, rooms for animals, eggs, diet and animal management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personalization
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Managing notes, updating the profile and language settings.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Access levels required for safe work.
